title: Power Rankings: Cavs jump six spots to No. 1
heading: 2009-10 Power Rankings: Week 9
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Sometimes we get it wrong and this is one of those times. Ever since we saw the Cavs lose to the Dirk-less Mavs in person and suggested they wouldn't go higher than No. 4 in the near future, they've been ruthless.
